papers.title: Mechanical behaviour of additively manufactured Ti6Al4V meta-crystals containing multi-scale hierarchical lattice structures
papers.abstract: The mimicry of crystalline microstructure at meso-scale creates a new class of architected materials, termed meta-crystals, and offers effective ways to significantly improve the toughness and eliminate the post-yield collapse of architected materials. This study investigated the mechanical behaviour of polygrain-like meta-crystals fabricated from Ti6Al4V by laser powder bed fusion. The mechanical behaviour of Ti6Al4V meta-crystals is governed by lattice structures across length-scales: the crystalline microstructure, architected crystal-like mesostructures and the quality of lattice struts. Due to the intricate architecture, significant processing defects were seen in the printed meta-crystals, in particular notch-like defects due to lack of fusion at the free surface of struts. Such defects raised stress concentration and reduced the load-bearing area of struts, hence significantly weakening the lattice struts. In addition, the as-printed condition was brittle due to the presence of acicular alpha' martensites. The defects and the as-printed brittleness led to the premature fracture of struts and compromised the benefits of the crystal-inspired mesostructures. The study subsequently conducted multiple measures to resolve this issue: increasing the strut diameter to reduce the influence of the process defects, and annealing to relieve internal stresses and regain ductility. The combination of the increase in strut diameter and annealing successfully enabled the crystal-like architected mesostructure to effectively improve the toughness of the meta-crystals.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文虽涉及LPBF制造和力学测试，但未讨论应力遮挡、疲劳或表面粗糙度等生物医学植入物关键指标，因此与用户研究方向关联度低。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address stress shielding, biomedical implant context, fatigue performance, or surface roughness/osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索仿晶格超晶体以提升点阵结构韧性。
summary_zh.method: 通过LPBF制备Ti6Al4V多晶超晶体，进行力学测试并采用退火处理。
summary_zh.result: 制造缺陷和针状马氏体导致脆性断裂，增大支柱直径和退火可改善韧性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩力学实验验证，未涉及疲劳或生物相关测试。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate whether polygrain-like meta-crystals can overcome the post-yield collapse of architected materials and improve toughness.
summary_en.method: Ti6Al4V meta-crystals with hierarchical lattice structures were fabricated by laser powder bed fusion and mechanically tested under compression, with post-processing annealing and strut diameter adjustments.
summary_en.result: Processing defects and as-printed martensitic brittleness caused premature strut fracture; annealing and increased strut diameter restored ductility and improved toughness.
summary_en.validation: The mechanical behavior was validated through compression testing of as-printed and annealed samples.

papers.title: Thermodynamic Consistent Neural Networks for Learning Material Interfacial Mechanics
papers.abstract: For multilayer materials in thin substrate systems, interfacial failure is one of the most challenges. The traction-separation relations (TSR) quantitatively describe the mechanical behavior of a material interface undergoing openings, which is critical to understand and predict interfacial failures under complex loadings. However, existing theoretical models have limitations on enough complexity and flexibility to well learn the real-world TSR from experimental observations. A neural network can fit well along with the loading paths but often fails to obey the laws of physics, due to a lack of experimental data and understanding of the hidden physical mechanism. In this paper, we propose a thermodynamic consistent neural network (TCNN) approach to build a data-driven model of the TSR with sparse experimental data. The TCNN leverages recent advances in physics-informed neural networks (PINN) that encode prior physical information into the loss function and efficiently train the neural networks using automatic differentiation. We investigate three thermodynamic consistent principles, i.e., positive energy dissipation, steepest energy dissipation gradient, and energy conservative loading path. All of them are mathematically formulated and embedded into a neural network model with a novel defined loss function. A real-world experiment demonstrates the superior performance of TCNN, and we find that TCNN provides an accurate prediction of the whole TSR surface and significantly reduces the violated prediction against the laws of physics.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的热力学一致神经网络方法可迁移至生物力学中的植入物-骨界面力学建模，但并未直接应用于植入物设计或昂贵仿真采样优化。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not solve expensive simulation sampling efficiency (uses experimental data), lacks uncertainty quantification, and is not directly applied to implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 提出热力学一致神经网络，学习材料界面牵引-分离关系。
summary_zh.method: 将热力学原理嵌入损失函数，用自动微分训练神经网络。
summary_zh.result: 准确预测整个牵引-分离关系表面，减少违反物理的预测。
summary_zh.validation: 使用真实实验数据验证模型预测能力。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a data-driven model for material interfacial traction-separation relations that obeys thermodynamic consistency.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed neural network is trained with a loss function encoding principles of energy dissipation and conservative loading.
summary_en.result: The proposed TCNN accurately predicts the full traction-separation surface while significantly reducing predictions violating physical laws.
summary_en.validation: The model is validated using sparse experimental data from a real-world multilayer material test.

papers.title: A Backward SDE Method for Uncertainty Quantification in Deep Learning
papers.abstract: We develop a probabilistic machine learning method, which formulates a class of stochastic neural networks by a stochastic optimal control problem. An efficient stochastic gradient descent algorithm is introduced under the stochastic maximum principle framework. Numerical experiments for applications of stochastic neural networks are carried out to validate the effectiveness of our methodology.

llm.relevance_to_user: 这篇论文提出了一种基于反向随机微分方程的不确定性量化方法，但并未涉及生物力学或有限元代理模型，因此与用户的研究方向关联度较低。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, biomechanics, or implant design; it focuses on a general UQ method for deep learning without biomedical or simulation efficiency context.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发深度学习中的不确定性量化方法。
summary_zh.method: 将随机神经网络建模为随机最优控制问题，使用反向SDE求解。
summary_zh.result: 数值实验验证了方法的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过随机神经网络的数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a probabilistic machine learning method for quantifying uncertainty in deep learning models.
summary_en.method: The method formulates stochastic neural networks as a stochastic optimal control problem and solves it using backward stochastic differential equations (BSDEs) under the stochastic maximum principle.
summary_en.result: Numerical experiments on stochastic neural network applications demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed methodology.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through numerical experiments on synthetic stochastic neural network problems.

papers.title: Fast and Uncertainty-Aware Directional Message Passing for Non-Equilibrium Molecules
papers.abstract: Many important tasks in chemistry revolve around molecules during reactions. This requires predictions far from the equilibrium, while most recent work in machine learning for molecules has been focused on equilibrium or near-equilibrium states. In this paper we aim to extend this scope in three ways. First, we propose the DimeNet++ model, which is 8x faster and 10% more accurate than the original DimeNet on the QM9 benchmark of equilibrium molecules. Second, we validate DimeNet++ on highly reactive molecules by developing the challenging COLL dataset, which contains distorted configurations of small molecules during collisions. Finally, we investigate ensembling and mean-variance estimation for uncertainty quantification with the goal of accelerating the exploration of the vast space of non-equilibrium structures. Our DimeNet++ implementation as well as the COLL dataset are available online.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文专注于分子动力学而非FEA替代建模或植入物设计，与用户方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on molecular energy prediction and uncertainty quantification for non-equilibrium molecules, with no connection to FEA surrogate modeling, biomedical implant design, structural mechanics, or any form of mechanical validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 扩展机器学习对非平衡态分子的预测能力，提升计算效率。
summary_zh.method: 提出DimeNet++模型，采用方向消息传递和集成不确定性量化。
summary_zh.result: 在QM9基准上提速8倍、精度提升10%，并在新数据集COLL上验证。
summary_zh.validation: 在平衡态(QM9)和非平衡态(COLL)分子数据集上数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To extend machine learning predictions to non-equilibrium molecular structures, which are crucial for reactive chemistry but poorly handled by existing equilibrium-focused models.
summary_en.method: Proposes DimeNet++, an improved directional message-passing neural network with an ensemble-based mean-variance estimation for uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.result: Achieves 8x speedup and 10% accuracy improvement over DimeNet on the QM9 benchmark, and demonstrates generalization to a new non-equilibrium collision dataset (COLL).
summary_en.validation: Validated on two computational benchmarks: QM9 for equilibrium molecules and the newly compiled COLL dataset for non-equilibrium configurations.

papers.title: Robotic-Assisted versus Manually Implanted Total Hip Arthroplasty: A Clinical and Radiographic Comparison.
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Component positioning during THA is one of the more critical surgeon-controlled factors as malposition has been associated with higher rates of hip dislocations, poor biomechanics, accelerated wear rates, leg length discrepancies (LLDs), and revision surgeries. In order to reduce the rates of component malposition and improve surgical accuracy, robotic-assisted THA has developed increased interest. The primary objective of this study was to compare patient outcomes following THA using the Mako Stryker robotic system (Stryker Orthopaedics, Mahwah, New Jersey) to outcomes in patients who underwent conventional instrumented THA. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Consecutive patients undergoing THA with a direct-lateral surgical approach from a single surgeon were reviewed. Patients were treated with either a robotic-arm assisted total hip arthroplasty (RTHA) or a conventional-instrumented total hip arthroplasty (CTHA). Minimum follow up was 16 months. RESULTS: Robotic-assisted THA significantly improved patient outcomes compared to conventional THA. No significant differences were observed in postoperative radiographic outcomes between the RTHA and CTHA cohorts. In our analysis, patients in the RTHA cohort compared to the CTHA cohort had significantly higher Western Ontario and McMaster Universities Arthritis Index (WOMAC) (P<0.001) and Harris Hip Scores (P<0.05) at final follow up. There were no significant differences between the RTHA cohort and CTHA cohorts in regard to cup inclination (°) (P=0.10), hip length difference (mm) (P=0.80), hip length discrepancy (mm) (P=0.10), and global offset difference (mm) (P=0.20). CONCLUSION: Further studies, particularly prospective randomized studies, are necessary to investigate the short- and long-term clinical outcomes, possible long-term complications, and cost-effectiveness of robotic-assisted THA in regard to improving outcomes and accuracy.

llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical outcome comparison between robotic-assisted and manual THA; it does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or contact mechanics in the femur, nor does it provide FE modeling or boundary conditions.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较机器人辅助与传统THA的临床和影像学结果。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性比较两组患者术后评分和影像学参数。
summary_zh.result: 机器人辅助组WOMAC和Harris评分显著更高，影像学无显著差异。
summary_zh.validation: 基于患者临床评分和影像学测量的对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To compare clinical and radiographic outcomes of robotic-assisted versus conventional total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A retrospective review of consecutive patients undergoing THA with either robotic-arm assistance or conventional instrumentation, with minimum 16-month follow-up.
summary_en.result: Robotic-assisted THA yielded significantly higher WOMAC and Harris Hip Scores, while radiographic parameters showed no significant differences between cohorts.
summary_en.validation: Clinical outcome scores and radiographic measurements were used to compare the two surgical approaches.
